description: Defines data structures and API functions for managing a vector of delete request entries, including initialization, destruction, addition of objects, and failure analysis.

classes.name: group_del_entry_t
classes.description: Structure representing a single delete request entry, including path, group ID, error code, and error message.

classes.name: group_del_vector_t
classes.description: Structure representing a collection of delete request entries.

methods.name: GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a group_del_vector_t structure.

methods.name: GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_AddObjectsToDelete
methods.description: Adds multiple objects to the delete vector based on provided paths and group IDs.

methods.name: GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_AddObjectNotDeleted
methods.description: Records a failed delete attempt for a specific object with error details.

methods.name: GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_AreAllPathsTheSameGroupId
methods.description: Checks if all entries in the vector belong to the same group ID.

methods.name: GROUP_DEL_VECTOR_FindFirstFailureIfAllFailed
methods.description: Finds the first failure in the delete vector within a specified range if all deletions failed.
